name: Soyuz-3
about: Soyuz-3 (1968-094A), a crewed vehicle (7K-OK), launched 1968 Oct 26. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1968 Oct 28), held fixed
